ERR_UART_BAD_ARG.message: A UART request is not valid

ERR_UART_BAD_PORT.message: UART {port} cannot be set up this way
ERR_UART_BAD_PORT.hint: Choose a UART the board has free: not the console's, and not one the board already uses.

ERR_UART_PORT_EXISTS.hint: Remove its provider first, or use another UART.

ERR_UART_BAD_BAUD.message: {baud} is not a baud rate this UART takes

ERR_UART_BAD_FORMAT.message: The UART's mode, parity or stop bits are not valid
ERR_UART_BAD_FORMAT.hint: Choose a mode and a parity from the lists, and 1 or 2 stop bits.

ERR_UART_BAD_PIN.message: {pin} of {device} cannot be a UART pin
ERR_UART_BAD_PIN.hint: Use pins of the ESP32-S3 itself; RTS and CTS go together or not at all.

ERR_UART_NO_MEM.message: UART {port} could not get its memory

ERR_UART_NOT_RAW.message: Provider {provider} carries runIT's frames, not raw bytes
ERR_UART_NOT_RAW.hint: Use a port made in a raw mode.

ERR_UART_NOT_DIRECT.message: Provider {provider} is not a UART port in direct mode

ERR_UART_TIMEOUT.message: UART provider {provider} did not finish sending in time
ERR_UART_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the rate, and the CTS line if the port uses flow control.
